services.name: Facilities Rental
services.desc: 303A First Street E Rental The Spiritwood Civic Centre is our community hall which can be rented for various events. The hall has a seating capacity of 500 seated, or 250 with tables and use of the dance floor. Stage dimensions are 45′ x 12′. There is a full kitchen, bar and meeting room which may also be rented for your event. All renters must sign and fill out a rental agreement, prior to renting. Before exiting the hall, each renter must complete the damage deposit check list in order to receive their damage deposit back. All rental rules and regulations are outlined in the rental agreement.
